Get, replace or remove layers

Source: R/scene.R
layer-management.Rd

Layers can be referred to by their (1-based) position or by name.

Usage

ngs_layer_names(x)

ngs_layer(x, which)

ngs_layer(x, which) <- value

ngs_drop_layer(x, which)

ngs_move_layer(x, which, index)

Arguments

x

A scene.

which

Position (integer) or name (string) of the layer. For ngs_drop_layer(), can also be a vector of positions or names.

value

A layer.

index

The new position of the layer.

Value

ngs_layer() returns a layer, ngs_layer_names() a character vector and the others the modified scene.

Details

ngs_layer() and its replacement form also make it easy to modify a layer in place, e.g. ngs_layer(sc, "segmentation")$segments <- ids.

Examples

sc <- ngs_scene(
  ngs_image_layer("precomputed://gs://x/em", name = "em"),
  ngs_segmentation_layer("precomputed://gs://x/seg", name = "seg")
)
ngs_layer(sc, "seg")
#> <segmentation layer> "seg" precomputed://gs://x/seg (0 segments)
ngs_layer(sc, "seg")$segments <- c("1", "2")
sc <- ngs_move_layer(sc, "seg", 1)
ngs_layer_names(sc)
#> [1] "seg" "em" 
sc <- ngs_drop_layer(sc, "em")
